_doc: The real campaign roster (canine HSA <-> human AS). Each candidate is seeded validation-ready by scripts/seed_real_roster.py. Docking candidates resolve their receptor from the curated verified target_library (by target) + PubChem ligand; the omics crux carries inline Megquier expression+strata (omics_source=megquier) so the REAL run_omics_review engine runs. Nothing here is auto-promoted.

candidates.title: Alpelisib (PI3Ka inhibitor) for PIK3CA-driven hemangiosarcoma
candidates.rationale: PIK3CA is recurrently mutated in canine HSA; alpelisib is an approved PI3Ka inhibitor. Falsify target engagement by docking into the verified PI3Ka pocket.

candidates.title: Toceranib (VEGFR2/KDR inhibitor) for angiogenesis-driven hemangiosarcoma
candidates.rationale: Hemangiosarcoma is a vascular tumor; toceranib (Palladia) is the clinical canine VEGFR-TKI. Falsify KDR engagement by docking (requires a redock-verified VEGFR2 entry in the library).

candidates.title: Is the PIK3CA-mutant HSA subset immunosuppressed? (TME deconvolution crux)
candidates.rationale: Falsification-first omics crux: test whether PIK3CA-mutant tumors carry an immunosuppressive TME signature, with the tumor-purity confound control (the catch the project rests on).
